revision: S2/P2: schematic S2 (signal nets wired); placement P2 = THT only (jacks, pots, vactrols, headers), power header moved to the bottom. SMD parts are parked off the board edge for group-by-group placement; nothing is routed.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer single hole pair at X7.5 (HOLE_X0 in case/tools/build_case.py; the Bread Modular Panel_6HP has the same pair). Skiff rails as the MIDI module: clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm as modules/vca-mix, 0.5 mm inside the 30.0 mm panel each side and 1.25 mm inside the rail gap at each end; held by the four jack nuts (the R0904N pots take no nut).

jack_rotation_note: Unrotated: T pad toward the top (Y-4.92), TN (Y+3.38), S (Y+6.48). Bodies are 9.0 mm across X, so three columns fit on a 9.75 mm pitch (courtyards 0.25 mm apart).
panel_order: Top to bottom (user brief 2026-10-21): MIDI in; MCO DETUNE + MIX knobs; AUDIO + CV bypass jacks; LOW CUTOFF knob; OUT. No BLAST button.
pot_part: Song Huei R0904N 50k linear (Bread Modular MCO/LOW value; user stock), vertical snap-in, tall shaft (L = 25 mm, knurled, no threaded bushing, no nut): the pot Bread Modular uses, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint
row_note: F clearances: J1 courtyard bottom Y30.8 to the MCO pot courtyards (shaft -5.1) Y36.9; pot courtyards (+8.65) Y50.65 to the bypass jacks (-6.25) Y55.75; jacks (+7.8) Y69.8 to CUTOFF (-5.1) Y76.9; CUTOFF (+8.65) Y90.65 to OUT (-6.25) Y102.25 (OUT at Y108.5 so its T pad clears the U7 courtyard on B). Side-by-side pots 14.5 mm apart (courtyards 1.9 mm apart), jacks 14.5 mm apart.
vactrol_part: Chinese VTL5C-type vactrol, Bread Modular VTL5C footprint unchanged (10.16 x 15.24 mm silk body). Mounted on B behind its own pot, as Bread Modular SVF does (body behind the pot, over the pot pin/bracket joints; leads soldered on F). Lying across X so the body stays within its row.

vactrols.note: behind CUTOFF exactly as modules/vca-mix (shaft offset -6.0, +1.3): body X1.4..16.6; LED pads (1, 2) at X15.35 under the pot body, LDR pads (3, 4) at X2.65 (solder the vactrol before the pot)

below CUTOFF, between its pins (pads to Y90.4) and OUT (T pad top Y102.3): body X12.9..28.1, Y91.4..101.6; rot 270 so the LED pads (1, 2) and the '+' mark sit at X14.15, away from the board edge; LDR pads (3, 4) at X26.85

power_header.orientation: Vertical at the bottom-left (user direction 2026-10-21: power socket at the bottom), as modules/midi and modules/8bit: rot 180 on B, pin 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom row Y116.0, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top row Y105.84, odd pins in the left column.
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the board, never past an edge. Envelope = 2x8 socket body (25.4 x 6.4 mm, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a ~1.2 mm key bump on either side; it stays inside the rail clear gap (Y120.5). Nothing THT sits under it: U5 ends at Y88.4, U7 and the OUT jack pads start at X12.9. B-side SMD placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall.

back_side_tht.note: UPDI (pin 1 UPDI at Y30.0, pin 2 GND at Y32.54), on B at the right edge between the MIDI jack and the MIX pot lug (Y40.5)

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer). DRC reports them as outside the board until then.
